entries.title: Psalms 146:4
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: That day - As soon as ever he is dead. Thoughts - All his designs and endeavours either for himself or for others.

entries.title: Psalms 146:6
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: For ever - Both because he liveth for ever to fulfil his promises, and because he is eternally faithful.
